# UnnecessarySemicolon

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `UnnecessarySemicolonInspection`

Stray semicolons — empty statements and the terminator right before `?>` in a
short echo tag — add nothing and are usually typos. Remove them.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{12,13,16,18} [Before]
<?php
declare(ticks=1);

for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) ;
while (next($items)) ;
do ; while (false);
if ($ready) ;
elseif ($late) ;
else ;

function tidy() {
    prepare();;
    ;
    return;
}
class Box {};
?>
<p><?= $title; ?></p>
<p><?= $title; $title = null; ?></p>
<p><?php show($title); ?></p>
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
declare(ticks=1);

for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) ;
while (next($items)) ;
do ; while (false);
if ($ready) ;
elseif ($late) ;
else ;

function tidy() {
    prepare();
    return;
}
class Box {}
?>
<p><?= $title ?></p>
<p><?= $title; $title = null; ?></p>
<p><?php show($title); ?></p>
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 12: Stray semicolon; remove it.</li>
<li>line 13: Stray semicolon; remove it.</li>
<li>line 16: Stray semicolon; remove it.</li>
<li>line 18: Stray semicolon; remove it.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UnnecessarySemicolon": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UnnecessarySemicolon

/**
 * @noinspection UnnecessarySemicolonInspection
 */
```
